description:
Ordering ahead is just a download away. Get the Starbucks® app for an easier way to enjoy your favorites and discover Rewards in every sip as a member. 

ORDER SEAMLESSLY 
• Order in the app when you’re on your way
• Customize and create your perfect drink
• Save your favorite stores
• View past orders & save custom drinks 
• Save payment methods and scan to pay in stores
• Tip your barista for your delicious drink

JOIN STARBUCKS® REWARDS
• Earn Stars to use on free food & drinks
• Start at Green status & level up to Gold or Reserve for exclusive benefits
• Enjoy a free drink on your birthday*, plus more time to redeem as you level up
• Try one free customization a month on Free Mod Mondays**
• Enjoy early access to new items
• Get Bonus Stars for digitally reloading your Starbucks Card (minimum $30)
• Explore games and offers just for you

SEND & SAVE eGIFTS 
• Save all your Starbucks Cards in one spot
• Send eGifts via email, text, or messaging app
• Choose from unique designs for every occasion

FIND A STORE
• See stores near you
• Get directions and hours
• View store amenities like drive-thru & Wi-Fi 

Must be a Starbucks Rewards member to enjoy exclusive member benefits and app features.

*Birthday Reward: 
Green members: Redeemable on member’s birthday only, at participating stores.   
Gold members: Redeemable for 7 days starting on member’s birthday, at participating stores. 
Reserve members: Redeemable for 30 days starting on member’s birthday, at participating stores.   
Free birthday drink must be standard menu size. 
Excludes alcohol and multi-serve items.  To qualify, you must have made at least one Star-earning transaction prior to your birthday each year. 
 
**Mod Monday: 
Redeemable at participating stores.  Members will receive one free customization each month, up to $2 (pre-tax) each. Not valid for use with Rewards or other offers, discounts or promotions.
